item.name: Fuel_Waste_Container
item.description: Empty sealable five-gallon container reserved for fuel-contaminated playa and cleanup material.
item.readyBeforeUse: The empty container is intact and its lid seals.
item.readyForNextPerson: The container is sealed; any contents are identified and reported to the Fuel Lead.
item.ifNotReady: Do not refuel. Tell the Fuel Lead.
